stories.title: Houthis seize strategic Red Sea port city of Mocha, push toward the Bab al-Mandeb chokepoint
stories.reason: The fall of Mocha and nearby Zuqar Island tightens Iran-backed rebels' grip on the strait linking Asia to Europe via the Suez Canal, prompting Yemen's government to call it a regional emergency requiring international intervention.

stories.title: ID-verification giant IDScan confirms breach exposing more than 150 million driver's licenses
stories.reason: Hackers pulled full names, license numbers and other government-ID data from the cloud platform used by venues and retailers nationwide to check customer identities, one of the largest identity-document breaches on record.

stories.title: DOJ investigates whether Nvidia structured its $20 billion Groq deal to dodge antitrust review
stories.reason: Prosecutors are scrutinizing the non-exclusive chip-technology licensing pact and Nvidia's hiring of Groq's founder, testing how far the AI giant can go in absorbing rivals' technology without triggering a formal merger review.

stories.title: Bangladesh's worst-ever measles outbreak nears 1,000 deaths as vaccination gaps persist
stories.reason: More than 166,000 suspected cases since March have overwhelmed hospitals, with experts blaming disrupted immunization programs during the country's post-uprising political turmoil for the world's largest current outbreak.

stories.title: Trump says Iran war will end 'immediately' after the midterms as oil stays above $100
stories.reason: Trump suggested Iran is prolonging the seven-month war to hurt Republicans politically and ruled out near-term negotiations, tying the conflict's endgame directly to the November election he's now headlining rallies for.

stories.title: Wall Street falls as producer prices rise and Treasury yields hit fresh highs ahead of Friday's CPI
stories.reason: August's 0.4% PPI increase matched estimates but did nothing to ease bond-market jitters, leaving Friday's consumer inflation report as the last major data point before the Fed's September 16 rate decision.

stories.title: California enacts first-in-the-nation laws requiring independent AI audits and creating an auditor registry
stories.reason: Governor Newsom's signing of AB 1405 and SB 813 stops AI companies from grading their own homework on state-law compliance, a template other states and Washington could follow as federal AI regulation stays gridlocked.

stories.title: Anthropic models three AI-driven US economic futures through 2030, with GDP up to 32% higher in the extreme case
stories.reason: The new Econ Scenario Explorer tool projects scenarios ranging from a modest 1.6% GDP boost to a $44.4 trillion 'extreme' economy, but also flags unemployment climbing as high as 17.9% and wages falling if automation outpaces new job creation.
